prs.title: Offline queue: retry checklist sync with backoff
prs.body:
Queued checklist edits now retry with exponential backoff instead of failing the sync.

- no data loss in the airplane-mode test
- sync errors on flaky Wi-Fi down from 4% to 0.3%

prs.title: Keyboard shortcuts for the checklist runner
prs.body: Space ticks the current item, J/K move between items. Crews asked for it at the September review.

prs.title: Quiet hours for non-urgent pages
prs.body: Low-severity pages wait until 7am local time.
